citation: Stadler et al. 2010. Chronic peripheral hyperinsulinemia in type 1 diabetic patients after successful combined pancreas-kidney transplantation does not affect ectopic lipid accumulation in skeletal muscle and liver. Diabetes 59:215.
protocol: 3-h 75 g glucose OGTT in water (Glukodrink), standard dose within 5 min, with basal samples; fasting EGP from d-[6,6-2H2]glucose tracer dilution.
population: 9 pancreas-kidney transplant recipients with type 1 diabetes (4 F / 5 M; age 50 +/- 8 y; BMI 26 +/- 3 kg/m2) and 9 nondiabetic controls (3 F / 6 M; age 53 +/- 9 y; BMI 26 +/- 2 kg/m2), means +/- SD.

reports.marker: plasma glucose (fasting, AUC, incremental AUC) during OGTT
plasma insulin (fasting, AUC, incremental AUC) during OGTT

note: Healthy nondiabetic controls are printed separately from the type 1 diabetic transplant group, n=9 each, means with SD. Only fasting EGP is tracer-measured, not postprandial. Units in mmol and mg/dL mixed in the same table.
